title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Final Staff Engineer scope overrides the broad business request: input only, one image OR audio per conversation; no microphone, PDF, comparison, streaming, generated audio, or chat persistence.
10 MB is an illustrative configurable prototype limit, not an agreed production limit.
Model names and capability fixtures are illustrative; the production catalog is not modified. Unknown metadata allows attempted submission and displays rejection.
ASR endpoint registration is tab-scoped sessionStorage mock data; no services or authentication are contacted.
Sample audio is a one-second silent WAV placeholder; displayed transcription is a synthetic scenario fixture.
Persona catalog and overlays are not staged; ai-engineer is an inferred persona.
Production upload, server file IDs, encoding, ASR routing, replica safety, and latency are not implemented in the standalone UI.
